% Native oracle for automatic 2D tick planning (TeX Live 2025).
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\newcommand{\auditcase}[2]{%
  \def\auditname{#1}%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{axis}[enlargelimits=false,scaled ticks=false,#2,
      xticklabel={\typeout{AXIS:\auditname:width:\pgfplotspointxaxislength:height:\pgfplotspointyaxislength}\typeout{TICK:\auditname:x:\tick}\pgfmathprintnumber{\tick}},
      yticklabel={\typeout{TICK:\auditname:y:\tick}\pgfmathprintnumber{\tick}}]
      \addplot[draw=none] coordinates {(0,0)};
    \end{axis}
  \end{tikzpicture}\par
}
\begin{document}
\auditcase{compact}{axis lines=middle,width=4cm,height=4cm,xmin=-1,xmax=1,ymin=-1,ymax=1}
\auditcase{small-box}{scale only axis,width=2cm,height=1cm,xmin=0,xmax=2,ymin=0,ymax=1}
\auditcase{sparse}{axis lines=middle,xmin=-1,xmax=6,ymin=-0.25,ymax=2.25}
\auditcase{retry}{scale only axis,width=4cm,height=4cm,max space between ticks=100,try min ticks=2,xmin=-4.4,xmax=4.4,ymin=-4.4,ymax=4.4}
\auditcase{negative}{scale only axis,width=4cm,height=4cm,max space between ticks=100,try min ticks=2,xmin=-2.99,xmax=-1.01,ymin=-2.99,ymax=-1.01}
\auditcase{positive}{scale only axis,width=4cm,height=4cm,max space between ticks=100,try min ticks=2,xmin=1.01,xmax=2.99,ymin=1.01,ymax=2.99}
\end{document}
